title: Scoring for Cholecystectomy outpatient readiness
summary: More and more surgical procedures are being performed on an outpatient basis in Germany and worldwide. This is possible with low risk thanks to ever-improving pain management and constantly evolving surgical methods. The primary goal of such outpatient surgery is patient safety.   As part of this study, the surgeon's assessment before and after the operation will be recorded in order to use a risk calculator to standardize the assessment of the possibility of outpatient surgery and thus minimize the risk. To this end, for all patients who have consented to participate in the study, the surgeon providing the information will collect data in the form of a questionnaire that records certain risk factors known from the literature. Immediately after the operation, the surgeon will complete another internationally validated questionnaire that reflects the difficulty of the operation. In addition, the duration of the operation, the length of hospital stay, and the postoperative pain reported will be evaluated.

interventions.name: Patients undergoing elective cholecystectomy are assessed preoperatively using a risk tool and postoperatively for complexity  intraoperatively and sonographically.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Scheduled minimally invasive cholecystectomy
Exclusion criteria:
No planned surgery
Different surgical technique
Inability to understand the questions.
